blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Pose-free 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) aims to bypass cumbersome Structure-from-Motion (SfM) by directly reconstructing scenes from unposed image sequences. In this work, we present CrossFit-GS, a deferred-commitment progressive framework that mitigates cumulative trajectory drift and breaks the self-reinforcing loop of distorted-map error propagation. Specifically, we partition the input sequence into interleaved subsets and maintain two complementary submaps. Each candidate pose is cross-refined against a frozen opposite submap that has never been optimized using the target frame, thereby providing an independent geometric reference for pose estimation. Checkerboard validation and spatial coverage safeguards further reject unreliable updates, and only verified poses are committed to their corresponding owner submap. Once the trajectory has been refined, the intermediate submaps are discarded and the final global representation is trained from scratch using the fixed refined poses. Extensive evaluations across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that CrossFit-GS substantially reduces cumulative trajectory drift and consistently improves both camera pose estimation and novel-view synthesis over existing methods.
blocks.zh: 免波斯3D高斯电镀(3DGS)旨在绕过繁琐的结构-从-Motion(SfM),直接从无位图像序列重建场景. 在这项工作中,我们介绍了CrossFit-GS,这是一个推迟承诺的渐进框架,它减轻了累积的轨迹漂移,打破了扭曲图误差传播的自我强化循环。 具体来说,我们把输入序列分割成互离子集,并保持两个互补的子图. 每个候选姿势对一个从未使用目标框架优化过的冷冻对面潜水图进行交叉改进,从而为姿势估计提供了独立的几何参考. 检查板验证和空间覆盖保障进一步拒绝不可靠的更新,只有经核实的姿势才会被承诺给相应的所有者子地图. 轨迹精炼后,中间子图被丢弃,最后的全球代表用固定精炼的姿势从头开始训练. 跨多个基准的广泛评价表明,CrossFit-GS可大大减少累积轨迹漂移,并不断改进相机对现行方法的估算和新视角综合。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) [ 16 , 1 ] has demonstrated remarkable success across a wide range of applications [ 29 , 23 , 28 , 36 ] . However, standard 3DGS heavily relies on pre-computed camera extrinsics from classical Structure-from-Motion (SfM) pipelines like COLMAP [ 32 ] . However, SfM preprocessing is computationally expensive, sensitive to rapid camera motion, and prone to failure in texture-less or low-overlap regions, hindering the practical deployment of 3DGS in real-time or streaming scenarios [ 13 , 11 , 22 ] .
blocks.zh: 3D Gaussian Splating(3DGS)[16,1]在广泛的应用中表现出显著的成功[29,23,28,36]. 然而,标准3DGS严重依赖于古典结构-自动(SfM)管道(如COLMAP[32])的预压缩相机外缘. 然而,SfM预处理在计算上费用昂贵,对快速相机运动敏感,容易在无纹理或低覆区域出现故障,阻碍了3DGS在实时或流化情景中的实际部署[13,11,22].

blocks.en: Recent efforts explore pose-free reconstruction paradigms that estimate camera trajectories and scene geometry directly from unposed image sequences [ 19 , 40 , 21 , 5 ] . Initial implicit methods [ 14 , 43 , 46 ] , such as BARF [ 20 ] and Nope-NeRF [ 2 ] , pioneered this direction by fitting coordinate-based Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) [ 25 ] alongside camera frame parameters. Leveraging the explicit representation and fast rasterization of Gaussians, frameworks like CF-3DGS [ 9 ] adapted this concept into a sequential regime by estimating relative poses with local Gaussian models while dynamically expanding a global scene representation. Follow-up studies improve complementary components of this pipeline by enhancing Gaussian coverage through hierarchical merging [ 15 ] , refining local pose estimation via feature and frequency regularization [ 44 ] , and introducing global trajectory constraints using long-range feature tracks [ 33 ] .
blocks.zh: 最近的努力探索了无姿势重建范式,直接从无姿势的图像序列中估算相机轨迹和场景几何[19,40,21,5]. 初始隐含方法[14,43,46],如BARF[20]和NOT-NERF[2],通过安装坐标基神经辐射场(NERFs)[25]与相机框架参数并列,开创了这一方向. CF-3DGS[9]等框架利用高斯人的明确代表性和快速光栅化,通过对当地高斯人模型的相对姿势进行估计,同时动态地扩大全球场景代表性,将这一概念调整为顺序制度. 后续研究改进了这一管道的互补性组成部分,方法是通过分级合并[15],提高高斯的覆盖率,通过特征和频率正规化改进当地布局估计[44],并采用远程特征轨道引入全球轨迹限制[33]。

blocks.en: Despite these empirical advances, existing progressive paradigms fundamentally struggle to reconcile local tracking tractability with global geometric consistency. Standard sequential frameworks estimate pairwise relative transformations from local Gaussian representations and compose them into a global trajectory [ 9 , 44 , 15 ] . Although this localized formulation makes pose tracking tractable, residual pairwise errors can accumulate along the sequence and are absorbed by the global scene representation [ 12 , 24 ] . Spatially flexible Gaussians can deform to accommodate these registration offsets, yielding deceptively low training-view reconstruction errors despite inaccurate camera trajectories [ 13 , 18 ] . As additional frames are incorporated, the evolving representation is repeatedly optimized to explain new observations under accumulated pose errors, causing geometric distortion to propagate throughout the reconstruction. While scene-level pose refinement offers a theoretical remedy for such cumulative drift, optimizing a camera pose against a scene representation trained on that very same observation creates a self-explanation shortcut [ 31 , 27 , 37 ] . Unresolved, this underlying dilemma often leads existing methodologies to focus heavily on refining initial pose estimates, rather than addressing systemic trajectory drift at its root. We highlight this self-explanation loop as a critical bottleneck in progressive camera-free reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些经验性的进展,但现有的进步范式从根本上努力调和本地的可追踪性和全球几何一致性。 标准顺序框架估计从当地高斯代表物成对的相对转变,并将其编成一个全局轨迹[9,44,15]. 虽然这种局部配方使得定位可跟踪,但残余的对偶误差可以沿着序列累积,被全球场景代表[12,24]吸收. 空间灵活的高斯人可以变形以适应这些注册抵消,尽管相机轨迹不准确[13,18],却产生了欺骗性低的训练视野重建错误. 随着其他框架的加入,不断演变的表述方式一再得到优化,以解释累积的观测结果有误,导致几何扭曲在整个重建过程中蔓延。 虽然场景水平的改进为这种累积漂移提供了理论上的补救,但优化相机对同一观测所训练的场景代表的姿势则创造了一个自我解释的捷径[31、27、37]。 这一根本的两难处境没有得到解决,往往导致现有方法大量侧重于改进初步估计,而不是从根源上解决系统轨迹漂移问题。 我们强调这种自我解释循环是渐进式无摄像机重建中的一个关键瓶颈。

blocks.en: To overcome this fundamental limitation, we propose CrossFit-GS, a progressive pose-free reconstruction framework built on a deferred-commitment protocol. Centered on dual-map information-flow isolation, CrossFit-GS strictly decouples camera pose refinement from scene map updates for unposed image streams. Specifically, the input sequence is partitioned into two interleaved temporal subsets ( A / B A/B folds), each maintaining an independent Gaussian submap. For an incoming frame, a candidate pose proposal is generated from the preceding motion estimate and cross-refined exclusively against the frozen opposite submap. To improve optimization stability, this cross-map pose refinement is strictly regulated by checkerboard validation masks and spatial coverage gates. Following our deferred-commitment principle, candidate pose updates are committed to the global trajectory and integrated into owner submap updates only after passing these validation checks. Once all camera extrinsics across the sequence are verified and frozen, the intermediate submaps are discarded, and a single global Gaussian representation is initialized and trained from scratch under the fixed trajectory. Through these coordinated strategies, CrossFit-GS effectively breaks the self-reinforcing pose–map error propagation loop, substantially mitigating cumulative trajectory drift while yielding highly accurate camera estimates and superior novel-view rendering quality.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这一根本的局限性,我们提议建立CrossFit-GS,这是建立在延期承诺协议基础上的渐进式免装重建框架。 CrossFit-GS以双映射信息流隔离为中心,严格脱钩相机从场景地图更新中呈现出对未配置图像流的完善. 具体地说,输入序列被分割成两个互换时间子集(A / B A/B折叠),每个子集保持独立的高斯子图. 对于即将到来的框架,从上述动议估计数中产生候选人的姿势提案,并完全对照被冻结的对角图进行交叉修改。 为了提高优化稳定性,这种跨映射姿势的完善,由检查板验证口罩和空间覆盖门严格规范. 按照我们推迟承诺的原则,候选人的更新将致力于全球轨道,并在通过这些验证检查后才纳入所有者子图更新。 一旦所有横跨序列的相机外观被验证和冷冻,中间的子图就会被丢弃,一个单一的全球高斯代表被初始化,并在固定轨迹下从头开始训练. 通过这些协调战略,CrossFit-GS有效地打破了自我增强的姿势-映射误差传播循环,大大缓解了累积的轨迹漂移,同时得出了高度准确的相机估计和优异的新颖视角渲染质量。

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: • We diagnose a fundamental bottleneck in COLMAP-free 3DGS, highlighting how accumulated pairwise errors distort the evolving scene representation and how reusing this pose-contaminated map for scene-level refinement creates a self-explanation shortcut that closes a self-reinforcing pose–map fitting loop. • We design a deferred-commitment progressive framework, CrossFit-GS, that prevents error propagation and suppresses trajectory drift by explicitly decoupling pose refinement from scene reconstruction through dual-map information isolation and cross-validation safeguards. • Extensive experiments validate that CrossFit-GS significantly suppresses trajectory drift, achieving state-of-the-art camera tracking and view synthesis.

blocks.en: 2.2 Sequential Pose-Free Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 2.2 连续的无波重建

blocks.en: Sequential COLMAP-free methods exploit temporal continuity to estimate camera motion and scene geometry through per-scene optimization [ 21 , 10 ] . Early implicit methods achieve pose-free reconstruction by jointly optimizing camera parameters alongside radiance fields [ 47 , 49 , 41 ] , employing frequency annealing in BARF [ 20 ] and monocular depth consistency in Nope-NeRF [ 2 ] to prevent optimization collapse. Transitioning to explicit representations [ 34 , 4 ] , CF-3DGS [ 9 ] estimates relative transformations between adjacent frames using local Gaussian models, composes them into a camera trajectory, and progressively grows a global Gaussian representation. Subsequent work improves different components of this pipeline. PCR-GS [ 44 ] introduces feature-reprojection and frequency-domain [ 26 ] regularization to improve local pose estimation. HT-3DGS [ 15 ] uses video frame interpolation to reduce the motion between adjacent observations and hierarchically trains and merges segment-specific Gaussian models to improve scene coverage. TrackGS [ 33 ] incorporates long-range feature tracks, track-constrained Gaussians, and multi-view geometric losses to jointly optimize camera parameters and the Gaussian representation under global trajectory constraints.

HT-3DGS [15] 使用视频帧内插,以减少相邻观测和等级列车之间的运动,并合并段特定高斯模型,以提高场景覆盖度. TrackGS [33] 融入了长距离特征轨迹,轨迹限制的高斯人,以及多景几何损失,以在全球轨迹限制下联合优化相机参数和高斯人代表.

blocks.en: To reconcile local tracking with global geometric consistency and suppress cumulative drift, CrossFit-GS introduces an observation-isolated pipeline under a deferred-commitment protocol (Fig. 2 ). Following previous benchmark evaluation protocols [ 44 , 15 , 9 , 33 ] , we evaluate on Tanks and Temples [ 17 ] using a frame-subsampling stride of 5 to simulate challenging wide-baseline camera motion. Additionally, we benchmark on CO3D-V2 [ 30 ] across representative scenes featuring diverse geometric and textural complexities. In line with standard evaluation setups, every 8th frame is held out as test views for novel view synthesis.
blocks.zh: 数据集. 按照先前的基准评价协议[44, 15, 9, 33], 我们利用5的帧-副样本脚步对Tanks and Temples [17] 进行评价,以模拟具有挑战性的广碱相机运动. 此外,我们以CO3D-V2[30]为基准,在具有多种几何和纹理复杂性的代表性场景中进行。 根据标准评价设置,每8帧都作为新颖视图综合的测试视图而保持.

blocks.en: Metrics. Novel view synthesis is evaluated using PSNR, SSIM [ 42 ] , and LPIPS [ 50 ] . Camera trajectory estimation is aligned via Sim ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{Sim}(3) Umeyama alignment and evaluated using Absolute Trajectory Error (ATE) as well as Relative Pose Errors for translation ( RPE t \text{RPE}_{t} ) and rotation ( RPE r \text{RPE}_{r} ) [ 20 , 2 ] .

blocks.en: Implementation Details. Training sequences are split into alternating A/B folds ( i mod 2 i\bmod 2 ). Local relative registration uses 1,000 1{,}000 iterations for reference view fitting and 300 300 for target tracking. Cross-map pose optimization uses Adam ( 1.0 × 10 − 3 1.0\times 10^{-3} ) for up to 100 100 iterations, gated by 20 % 20\% initial alpha coverage and checkerboard-masked validation. A pose update is committed if validation loss improves by > 1.0 × 10 − 5 >1.0\times 10^{-5} while retaining ≥ 50 % \geq 50\% visible coverage. Frozen poses are then used to train a unified global Gaussian map for 500 × N 500\times N steps from scratch.

blocks.en: 4.2 Novel View Synthesis Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.2 小说视图综合评价

blocks.en: Table 1 and Table 2 report the quantitative visual quality on the Tanks and Temples and CO3D-V2, respectively. CrossFit-GS consistently outperforms existing baselines across both datasets. On Tanks and Temples, our method achieves a mean PSNR of 26.246 26.246 dB, representing a 4.315 4.315 dB gain over CF-3DGS and a 0.979 0.979 dB advantage over TrackGS. Similarly, on CO3D-V2, it yields an overall mean PSNR of 31.393 31.393 dB, showing marked improvements on complex scenes such as plant_50907.
blocks.zh: 表1和表2分别报告了坦克和圣殿以及CO3D-V2的定量视觉质量。 交叉 Fit-GS持续超过两个数据集的现有基线。 在坦克和庙宇方面,我们的方法实现了平均PSNR26.246 26.246 dB,比CF-3DGS增加4.315 4.315 dB,比TrackGS增加0.979 0.979 dB。 同样,在CO3D-V2上,其总的平均值PSNR为31.393 31.393 dB,在植物_50907等复杂场景上显示出明显的改进.

blocks.en: These gains validate our observation-isolated design. Existing progressive methods often absorb residual pose errors into flexible Gaussian primitives, causing geometric artifacts and texture blur (Fig. 3 and 4 ). By refining poses against frozen out-of-fold submaps and deferring global map updates until trajectories are fixed, CrossFit-GS prevents error propagation and renders sharper geometry and fine details.
blocks.zh: 这些成果证实了我们观测孤立的设计。 现有的渐进方法往往吸收残余物形成灵活的高斯原始物,造成几何文物和纹理模糊(图3和图4). CrossFit-GS通过对冷冻的外侧子图进行改进,并将全球地图更新推迟到轨迹固定之后,防止错误传播,使几何和细节更加清晰。

blocks.en: 4.3 Trajectory Estimation Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.3 轨迹估计评价

blocks.en: Table 3 reports the quantitative trajectory errors across both benchmarks. CrossFit-GS delivers the highest camera tracking precision, reducing the ATE on Tanks and Temples from 0.024 0.024 for CF-3DGS to 0.010 0.010 , which represents a 58.3 % 58.3\% improvement and surpasses TrackGS ( 0.014 0.014 ). On CO3D-V2, our method achieves a mean ATE of 0.009 0.009 alongside a mean RPE t = 0.344 \mathrm{RPE}_{t}=0.344 .
blocks.zh: 表3报告了两个基准的量化轨迹差错。 交叉 Fit-GS提供最高的摄像头跟踪精度,将Tanks和Temples上的ATE从CF-3DGS的0.024 0.024减少到0.010 0.010,这代表58.3%的改进,超过了TrackGS(0.014 0.014). 在CO3D-V2上,我们的方法与平均RTE t = 0.344\mathrm{RPE}_{t}=0.344的同时,实现了平均ATE 0.009 0.09。

blocks.en: The trajectory visual comparisons in Fig. 5 demonstrate that CrossFit-GS preserves global motion paths under complex camera movements. This gain stems from the interaction between local pose initialization and out-of-fold refinement. The local stage provides short-range motion estimates, while cross-fit refinement checks those estimates against the multi-view context of the opposing submap. Supported by spatial anchoring and the accept-or-keep verification, these safeguards limit local registration errors and yield stable long-term trajectories.
blocks.zh: 图5中的轨迹视觉比较表明,CrossFit-GS在复杂的相机运动下保留了全球运动路径. 这一收益来源于当地姿势初始化与外形完善之间的相互作用. 局部阶段提供短程运动估计,而跨尺寸精细化则对照对立子图的多视角背景来检查这些估计. 在空间锚定和接受或保持核查的支持下,这些保障措施限制当地登记错误,并产生稳定的长期轨迹。

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.4 阅读研究

blocks.en: 4.4.1 Contribution of Each Component
blocks.zh: 4.4.1 每个构成部分的贡献

blocks.en: To quantify the contribution of each core component in CrossFit-GS, we conduct systematic ablation experiments on Tanks and Temples (Table 4 ).
blocks.zh: 为了量化CrossFit-GS中每个核心部分的贡献,我们在Tanks和Temples上进行了系统的消化实验(表4)。

blocks.en: Replacing local tracking with a naive cross-map optimization scheme (Naive cross-fit) yields a substantial performance leap, reducing ATE from 0.024 0.024 to 0.017 0.017 and increasing PSNR from 21.931 21.931 dB to 25.486 25.486 dB. This validates that optimizing target camera poses against an out-of-fold frozen submap successfully breaks the target-to-map self-fitting loop.
blocks.zh: 以天真横图优化计划(Naive cross-fit)取代本地跟踪产生实质性性能飞跃,ATE从0.024 0.024降至0.0170.017,PSNR由21.931 21.931 dB增至25.486 25.486 dB. 这验证了优化目标相机对一个外倍冷冻的子图所构成的功能,成功打破了目标到地图的自适应循环.

blocks.en: Spatially interleaving optimization and validation pixels via checkerboard masking ensures unbiased candidate evaluation; removing it (w/o Checkerboard) degrades both ATE ( 0.015 0.015 ) and PSNR ( 25.733 25.733 dB). Similarly, disabling the accept-or-keep mechanism (w/o Accept-or-Keep) increases tracking error, confirming the necessity of filtering out unhelpful pose updates using held-out photometric evidence.
blocks.zh: 通过检查板遮盖进行空间间隔优化和验证像素可确保无偏见的候选评价;移除(w/o检查板)可降解ATE(0.015 0.015)和PSNR(25.733 25.733 dB)。 同样,使接受或保持机制(w/o Accept-or-keep)失效会增加跟踪错误,从而确认有必要利用搁置的光度测量证据过滤出无益的更新。

blocks.en: Boundary and coverage controls provide critical safeguards against divergence. Omitting the coverage gate (w/o Coverage Gate) impairs pose alignment ( ATE = 0.016 \text{ATE}=0.016 ) under limited spatial overlap, while removing the retention guard (w/o Retention Guard) drops PSNR to 25.909 25.909 dB due to pose drift into unobserved space. Combining all components into Full CrossFit-GS achieves the best trajectory accuracy and NVS fidelity.
blocks.zh: 边界和覆盖范围管制为防止分歧提供了重要的保障。 安装覆盖门(w/o scovering Gate)会损害在有限的空间重叠下形成对齐(ATE = 0.016\text{ATE }= 0.016),同时拆除保留护卫(w/o leading Guard)会因漂移到无人观察的空间而将PSNR降至25.909 25.909 dB. 将所有组件合并到Full CrossFit-GS中,可以实现最佳的轨迹精度和NVS的忠诚度.

blocks.en: 4.4.3 Diagnosing Target-to-Map Self-Explanation
blocks.zh: 4.4.3 分析目标对地图的自我解释

blocks.en: To directly test our core hypothesis, we evaluate four variants across two orthogonal factors—whether the reference map incorporates the target view prior to refinement, and whether it remains frozen during optimization: Target-conditioned trainable (TCTM), Target-conditioned frozen (TCFM), Target-excluded trainable (TETM), and Target-excluded frozen (TEFM, ours).

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented CrossFit-GS, a deferred-commitment framework designed for COLMAP-free 3DGS. By enforcing strict observation isolation and refining each candidate pose against a frozen out-of-fold submap, our approach effectively eliminates the target-to-map self-explanation loop and prevents pose errors from being absorbed into Gaussian primitives. Experiments on benchmarks demonstrate that CrossFit-GS achieves substantial improvements in both global trajectory accuracy and novel-view rendering. Furthermore, our diagnostic studies confirm that isolating target-frame observations during pose refinement is crucial for preventing trajectory drift and reconstructing geometrically faithful 3D representations.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了CrossFit-GS,一个为COLMAP免费3DGS设计的延期承诺框架. 通过实施严格的观测隔离,并精炼每个候选者对一个冰冻的外层潜水图的姿势,我们的方法有效地消除了目标到地图的自我解析循环,防止了被高斯原始人吸收的错误. 关于基准的实验表明,CrossFit-GS在全球轨迹精确度和新视角渲染方面都取得了实质性的改进。 此外,我们的诊断研究证实,在改进布局时隔离目标框架观测对防止轨迹漂移和重建几何忠实的立体表示至关重要。
